offPlatform.description: A scan run that evaluated a benchmark made for another platform than the host (ADR 0019 and ADR 0016, amendments of FREES-161). Never a compliance figure.

description: Normalized report built from heterogeneous inputs. Every section has an explicit status; missing or invalid input is never a pass. Timestamps are supplied by the caller and never generated. Version 2.1 adds sections.compliance.host_coverage, which accounts for every target host of an evidence collection; a 2.0 document has no such key.
title: FreeSecDev normalized report, version 2
